Frequently Asked Questions

What does CELVION engineer, and how is it made?

CELVION engineers sustainable material solutions from renewable natural plant fibres using precision automated moulding to replace conventional packaging without compromising quality or performance.

Are CELVION materials safe for food contact?

Yes. All product families comply with US FDA 21 CFR and European BfR food contact standards. Produced under certified ISO 9001 and ISO 22000 systems, our materials are non-toxic, PFAS-free, and heat-safe.

How does CELVION approach sustainability?

Guided by our principle "Nature inspires possibility. Innovation transforms possibility into progress," we engineer 100% renewable plant-fibre solutions that help global brands eliminate plastic dependency.

Can we get custom sizes or private-label branding?

Yes. We provide complete custom engineering — including proprietary mould tooling, structural sizing, embossed logo branding, and private-label packaging for global OEMs and distributors.

What is CELVION’s production capacity and facility footprint?

CELVION operates a 90,000 m² automated manufacturing facility with a production capacity of 150 tons monthly, supported by a 150+ member team supplying partners across 15+ countries.

What does the name CELVION mean?

CELVION combines CEL (Cellulose & natural fibres), VI (Vision & vitality), and ON (Continuity & progress) — representing a long-term commitment to sustainable material innovation.

What is CELVION’s brand promise and philosophy?

Our brand promise is "Sustainable innovation engineered with uncompromising quality," transforming renewable natural resources into high-performance solutions for modern industries.
